objective:
Goal: a line-by-line blame view, with code grouped by commit, is visible. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "Above the file content, click Blame.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, store the main heading of the page you end on as 'landed_on', then verify the goal on screen.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: Use the visible UI to reach a line-by-line blame view with code grouped by commit; role=button; text="Blame" | HINTS: container=File view above the file content
actions.instr: Clicking the Blame button to open the line-by-line blame view

actions.intent: PRIMARY: wait for the blame page heading "Readme.md" to load
actions.instr: Waiting for Readme.md heading to load on the blame page

actions.intent: whether a line-by-line blame view is present (in the Readme.md file region)
actions.instr: Checking whether the line-by-line blame view is present

actions.intent: whether code grouped by commit is present (in the Readme.md blame region)
actions.instr: Checking whether code grouped by commit is present
